note: Every datatype in the teaching-video pipeline: what each transformation is FOR, its exact shape, who produces it, what validates it, and the gate rule. A new artifact adheres to the standard iff it validates under its validator AND honors its gate rule. Meta-check in check.py.

transforms.purpose: Pin the exact prose under production. Every downstream claim traces to these bytes.
transforms.validator: diff --stat after every run; blanks intact
transforms.gate_rule: Blanks collapsed, prose edited, or frozen chapter touched = BLOCKED.

transforms.purpose: Assign every paragraph a voice and direction. The renderer never decides, only resolves.
transforms.validator: storyboard validator 0 errors 0 warnings; M18 three-part remap proof
transforms.gate_rule: UNCAST defaults, split paragraphs, or hand-edited overrides = BLOCKED.

transforms.purpose: Voice the line well on free Fish S2: beats, title weight, seat tags. Tags prefix only; bodies never rewritten.
transforms.gate_rule: Body rewrite, tag >3, or S2 migration without byte-proof = BLOCKED.

transforms.purpose: Citation Deva + IAST + literal + final per term. Display text never comes from a folded key.
transforms.validator: V5 (confirmed terms carry citation Deva); M15/M23
transforms.gate_rule: Confirmed term without citation Deva, or machine-derived Deva = BLOCKED.

transforms.purpose: Owner act pinning exact inputs + builder version. Revocable by deleting the file.
transforms.gate_rule: No approval, stale SHA, or self-granted = no render, ever.

transforms.purpose: One TTS call per same-section same-voice group (prosody over beats). Re-runs are cache hits.
transforms.producer: render_chapter.py (Fish s2.1-pro-free only; human clips for singleton phonemes)
transforms.validator: content-hash hit (size + sha256); receipts append-only; -21dB mean, man 75%
transforms.gate_rule: Paid model string, missing group at assemble, or unwitnessed call = BLOCKED.

transforms.purpose: Word-onset timings for karaoke. Measured, never distributed.
transforms.producer: align_group.js (MMS; en-IN narration, sa-IN chant; folding for aligner only)
transforms.validator: 1:1 row map; mean >= 0.85; zero non-monotonic; 200-threshold chunk routing
transforms.gate_rule: Mean under bar, nonmono, or stale rows (opath deleted pre-run) = stop the group.

transforms.purpose: Group-aligned mp4 chunk + proof pack. Review unit; chapter mp4 is the ship unit.
transforms.producer: run_blocks.py + prove_clip.py (one video build at a time, lock as code)
transforms.validator: gate_visual machine lines + eye read with filed notes + H6 word-row match
transforms.gate_rule: Red proof, missing meta, or unwitnessed frames = no concat.

transforms.purpose: One canonical file per deliverable, provably what its evidence claims.
transforms.producer: concat proven parts; verify; voices; Qwen taste-only; owner ears; golden seal
transforms.validator: golden tolerances (duration 2s, cue order/drift, white 5pp, cuts)
transforms.gate_rule: Unbound meta, stale part, model-verdict-as-gate, or new R2 root key = BLOCKED.
